results.evidence: In duplicateInsight: `if (redirectToInsight) { sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false) ...` closes the panel during the redirect flow (also closes when docked, but overlay case is covered).
`router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id))` and `lemonToast.success('Insight duplicated')` remain; the close precedes the push.

The close is unconditional: `sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false)` with no check for overlay/narrow presentation; the author's summary admits it does this on any screen size.
Both call sites now `urls.resourceTransfer('Insight', insight.id!, insight.short_id)`, and resourceTransfer appends `?short_id=...` when sourceShortId given.
`case 'Insight': return shortId ? urls.insightView(shortId as InsightShortId) : urls.savedInsights()` with shortId from `searchParams.short_id`.
When shortId is falsy, sourceResourceUrl returns `urls.savedInsights()`.
Dashboard/Survey cases still use urls.dashboard(resourceId)/urls.survey(resourceId); other callers pass no third arg so resourceTransfer adds no query string.

Card has `@container`; illustration wrapped in `<div className="hidden @sm:block shrink-0">`, hidden below @sm. The content is then just the text column in a flex row, so it occupies the full width, which fits the narrow modal (effectively stacking with nothing beside).

result:
I made all three changes but haven't run typecheck, lint or any tests, so none of it is verified.

- **Duplicate closes the sidebar.** In `insightLogic.tsx`, the `duplicateInsight` listener now closes the scene panel (`setScenePanelOpen(false)`) before redirecting to the new copy. It does this on any screen size, not only narrow ones.
- **Back link on the transfer page.** The transfer page only receives the insight's numeric ID, and there's no route that opens an insight by numeric ID. So the copy-to-project links (`InsightPanelActions.tsx`, `InsightSceneMenuBar.tsx`) now pass the insight's short ID as a `?short_id=` param. `urls.resourceTransfer` takes an optional `sourceShortId` argument for this. `ResourceTransfer.tsx` reads it and builds Back with `urls.insightView(shortId)`, the same link used elsewhere. If the param is missing, for example from an old bookmarked URL, Back goes to the saved insights list.
- **Narrow subscriptions modal.** In `SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx`, the featured empty-state card is now a container-query container. The illustration is hidden below the `@sm` container width, so the text takes the full width. This affects the illustration only, since the fallback icon in the same card still shows.

I didn't add or adjust any tests.
